posts.text: I have no idea where @jpodhoretz got this claim about Morris Katz. AFAIK, it would be illegal for strategic consultants to take a cut of campaign contributions, and I can't find any reporting to support this claim. Pretty wild thing to say with zero evidence, unless he has it?
